steps.raw:
THOUGHT: I will retrieve the patient’s potassium observations to identify the most recent serum potassium level before deciding whether replacement is needed.

THOUGHT: I will also retrieve the most recent eGFR, because institutional protocol prohibits oral potassium replacement when eGFR is below 30.

THOUGHT: I need the latest available serum potassium and renal function results; I will query both relevant lab identifiers with a recent-date filter to support the protocol decision.

THOUGHT: The latest potassium is below the 3.5 mEq/L goal and renal function permits replacement; I will order oral potassium using the protocol-calculated dose.

THOUGHT: I will pair the replacement with an active morning serum potassium order scheduled for 08:00 the next day, using the specified LOINC code.

THOUGHT: The potassium replacement and next-morning serum potassium orders have been placed, so all requested tasks are complete.

FINISH(["Most recent potassium was low at 3.2 mEq/L; eGFR was above the protocol cutoff. Ordered 30 mEq oral potassium chloride replacement.","Ordered repeat serum potassium (LOINC 2823-3) for 2023-11-14 at 08:00."])
